mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals labor market tightness, leading to wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL is rising.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor demand, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 300,000.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 10% YoY and GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% YoY, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST YoY < -10% and GDPC1 YoY < 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50 basis points in a month signals a pivot towards easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases > 50bps.
